steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Haha... This again... In that same place...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Was that the place where you were cut in half? Where you were almost devoured, and could only survive by hiding yourself?

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: I didn't rise from the darkness, break free from chaos, condense into flesh and blood, and unleash all this Mania for you!!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: We were not born to be your food! I don't accept that!! My flesh, blood, and consciousness belongs to me! Nothing about me belongs to you!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: I will take back everything you took from me! I will take back my own power!

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: If you want to devour me too, I'll kill and eat you right here, then go find her!!
Anger, hatred, resentment, stubbornness... You feel a plethora of intense emotions through your shackles, many of which are quite familiar.

steps.speaker: Phantom Shadow
steps.content: This is our mine! It belongs to Syndicate!
The Rustfire members who were devoured...
Its emotions are so similar to theirs. That's why the Corpus of BR-002 was so obsessed with the Drifter Camp and devouring Rustfire.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Scores of people probably got infected with Mania, but there weren't many reports of them turning into Corruptors. But I imagine quite a few of those infected in Inner Bay became Sinners.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: These were people who mined at the foot of DisSea's Black Ring. They refused to bow their heads even in the face of the great explosion. They had the skills, and they had perseverance. Weren't they cool?

They were the last witnesses of the golden age, and the progenitors of Rustfire's resolve. These were the people who made the Corpus of BR-002 so strong. This is why it showed so much strength and perseverance even when cut in half.
Perhaps monsters born from Mania all love such pure spirits, and yearn to drive them into despair. Whether it's Sinners or crowds... this was why they came out of chaos into existence.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: But you are not them after all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your flesh and blood belong to human beings, and so do your ideals. You took everything from them to rebel against your own destiny. But likewise, the people you robbed were also not born for you. They're also not your food.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Perhaps Syndicate will still be in chaos, but that's their business. It's not a hunting ground for a monster like you. You should stop right now!
It strikes the ground angrily, spewing out contamination with each blow.
